reviews.t: My skin loves it!
reviews.x: I have read a lot about the benefits of Emu oil and have to say so far so good. It leaves my skin feeling soft and doesn't clog my pores. I have read that Emu oil penetrates deeper into the skin and if used on top of your regular lotion, it will help that product penetrate past the epidermis producing greater benefits.  This product moisturizes great without leaving my skin feeling greasy or oily. Just remember, a little goes a long way.

reviews.t: EMU oil

It's too early to report on growth, however I will be purchasing this item again it seems like a lovely moisturizer for those hard winter months.

reviews.t: I love this oil!

claims.text: Many reviewers question the product's purity, describing it as thin, watery, or not genuine emu oil.
Several reviewers report packaging problems, including leaking or defective bottles and spillage during shipping.
Positive reviewers praise the oil as moisturizing and hydrating for skin and hair, noting it absorbs quickly and isn't greasy.
Some reviewers report the oil arrived rancid or with a bad smell.
A few reviewers are satisfied with the quality and value, with some noting a little goes a long way.
